title: Doring & Roadkill grow into ECW’s final tag champions
summary: An odd-couple team develops into reliable contenders. After a managerial betrayal and repeated setbacks, Danny Doring and Roadkill finally win the tag championships.

chapters.title: Elektra turns on the team
chapters.result: Doring and Roadkill lose to Anderson and Wiles.
chapters.context: Their manager’s betrayal creates another obstacle on the path toward the championships.

chapters.title: The long chase ends in gold
chapters.result: Doring and Roadkill defeat the FBI for the tag titles.
chapters.context: The victory makes them the final tag champions of the original ECW.
